definitions.explanation: The quality of being able to bend or change easily; the ability to adapt to different circumstances.

examples.japanese: {考|かんが}え{方|かた}に{柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}がない。
examples.english: Their way of thinking lacks flexibility.

examples.japanese: {柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}のある{対応|たいおう}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
ストレッチで{体|からだ}の{柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}を{高|たか}める。
examples.english: To improve body flexibility through stretching.

notes:
Formed from {柔軟|じゅうなん} (flexible) + {性|せい} (quality/nature). Can refer to both physical flexibility (of the body) and mental or organizational flexibility.

PHYSICAL SENSE:
- {体|からだ}の{柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}: body flexibility
- {柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}を{高|たか}める: to improve flexibility

ABSTRACT SENSE:
- {考|かんが}え{方|かた}の{柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}: flexibility of thinking
- {柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}のある{対応|たいおう}: a flexible response

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}がある/ない: to have/lack flexibility
- {柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}に{欠|か}ける: to be lacking in flexibility
- {柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}を{持|も}つ: to possess flexibility

RELATED:
- {柔軟|じゅうなん}: flexible (na-adjective, the base word)
- {適応性|てきおうせい}: adaptability
- {弾力性|だんりょくせい}: elasticity, resilience
